title: My orders asks the gym server every 10 seconds even when no order is waiting
what: While My orders is open, the app asks the database for the full order list every 10 seconds, with no end, even when every order is already collected or cancelled. Each ask adds to the shared free download traffic, and nothing at MettleUp watches that traffic.
expected: Ask often only while an order is still Ordered or Ready, slow down or stop otherwise, and have the traffic counted against the free limit somewhere MettleUp looks.
how_often: every 10 seconds per open My orders page
fix_line: Only keep asking while an order is open, and back off after a few minutes

title: Each visit to the Gym tab reloads the shop list, the orders and the gym with no pause
what: Every time a member comes back to the Gym tab, the app asks the database again for the product list, the order list and the gym itself, even if it asked a few seconds ago. Diet plans and hours wait 10 minutes between asks, but these three do not. Members who switch tabs often multiply the shared free traffic.
expected: The shop list, orders and gym check wait a few minutes between automatic asks, like the hours and diet plans do; a pull still asks at once.
fix_line: Give the automatic shop, orders and gym asks the same 10-minute pause the hours use
